newsitem.title: USA: Chattanooga, Tenn., hospital cuts 640 jobs.
newsitem.headline: Chattanooga, Tenn., hospital cuts 640 jobs.

text.p: Erlanger Health System in Chattanooga, Tenn., will eliminate 640 jobs in a restructuring aimed at cutting $44 million from operating costs next year, the Chattanooga Free Press said Monday.
The plan will reduce the workforce from 3,200 to 2,550 at the hospital, which remains one of the largest employers in Chattanooga and Hamilton County.

Hospital officials said earlier that 1,100 jobs would be changed, eliminated or consolidated as part of a three-month review of operations. Some employees whose jobs were eliminated were reassigned, so the net job loss was only 640.
The hospital had operating losses of $5.8 million for the first seven months of the fiscal year.

Its Series 1993 bonds, issued by the Chattanooga-Hamilton County Hospital Authority, have an underlying rating of A-plus from Standard & Poor's Corp and A-1 from Moody's Investors Service. Most of the $164.9 million of outstanding debt is AAA-insured by Financial Security Assurance.
